incident.name: France Titres National Identity Breach
incident.vector: Unauthorized access to government identity infrastructure
incident.description: France's national identity document agency breached — up to 19M records including national ID cards, driver's licenses, and passport-linked data. CNIL, Paris Prosecutor, and ANSSI all investigating. Affects a significant portion of the French population.
incident.root_cause: Unauthorized access to government identity infrastructure
incident.lessons: National identity infrastructure requires the highest security standards. Breach of identity documents enables cascading fraud and social engineering at national scale.

relatedIncidents.name: SamSam Ransomware (Atlanta)
relatedIncidents.description: SamSam ransomware crippled City of Atlanta for weeks. $51K ransom demanded, $17M in recovery costs.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Exposed RDP with weak credentials, no offline backups
relatedIncidents.lessons: RDP must never be exposed to internet. Offline backups are essential for government.
